predictions.prompt: Does the prediction for x = 2 go up or down?

questions.stem: What does the first stump fit?
questions.explanation: Boosting fits each new tree to what the current model gets wrong, the residuals, not to the outcomes themselves; the mean is the starting model.

questions.stem: After one round the MSE is {{byhand.round.0.mse_after:.4f}}. Why not zero?
questions.explanation: A depth-one tree can only produce two values, so four distinct outcomes cannot all be matched; the rate of 0.5 also takes only half of each correction.
